items.title: What Mitsui High-tec (TSE:6966)'s Upgraded 2026 Forecast and Dividend Hike Means For Shareholders

At the same time, the company raised its full-year forecasts for sales, profit and earnings per share, citing robust demand, cost controls and favorable foreign exchange movements.
